note: No public queryable zoning district service found for Rowan County, KY. The City of Morehead, which zones the city and its extraterritorial area, publishes its official zoning map only as a PDF (advancemoreheadcity.com) and keeps the official map with the City Planner (Chapter 154, s.154.144). The county parcel viewer (rowan2.connectgis.com) is a login-gated viewer (returned 504 when checked), and gismaps.org and countyoffice.org list no zoning REST service. The ArcGIS Online Zoning results are for other places, and the Rowan County hits are North Carolina's.
